2906.doc:
小天狼星回响
    ※与场上距离最近的友方单位产生链接，优先级为：巫师-伙伴-生物，有连接特效，和目标的距离超出一定范围（距离可配置）时中断链接
    ※你获得的治疗效果会按照配置的比例分享给链接目标
    ※链接每存在一段时间，为被链接目标添加一次add buff，add buff可叠层；达到最大时间时链接双方再获得一个额外的extra buff；链接中断后清除双方的extra buff,并会在短时间内逐层失去add buff
    ※迭代：当对非巫师单位的链接中断时，若该单位已经获得extra buff，则不剥夺该单位已有buff
    ※迭代2：区分巫师和生物的extra buff
    ※迭代3：取消使用check_has_buffs和remove_buff_by_id接口
    ※迭代4：不断链的情况下，怪物连满层后才断
    ※迭代5：在现在的连线规则上，在怪物这一层优先级，把距离排序前面再加一个攻击力排序，在范围内先找攻击力最高的，攻击力一样或者都为0，再按照距离去选
            加一个缓冲距离，比如现在配置连线距离是60，缓冲距离配置为10，60范围内找目标去连，连上之后，需要超过70才会断掉链接，怪物连满自动断这个机制不改
    ※迭代6：连接巫师满层之后自己获得不同的extra buff，连接怪物满层之后自己获得有限时长的extra buff，断链之后再次逐层失去
    ※迭代7：不再链接巫师，链接巫师由其他buff管理
    ※迭代8：配置仅连巫师或怪物
    ※迭代9：extra buff可以叠加，但是特效不叠加

details.title: Notes and Chords
items: MP Costs are transformed into musical notes. Play your Cards in set orders, and you will obtain different Bonuses for every 3 Cards played.

details.title: Rising Arpeggio
items: When the MP Costs of the 3 Cards played are in ascending order, you will fire as many musical projectiles as the MP Cost of the last Card played, each Damaging your opponent for <color=focus_dark>95%</color> of your Attack.

details.title: Falling Arpeggio
items: When the MP Costs of the 3 Cards played are in descending order, the effect of the last Card will repeat itself with lowered effectiveness.

details.title: Suspended Chord
items: When the MP Costs of the 3 Cards played are 5, 6, and 2 respectively and in the same order, an MP Regen Bonus will be granted for 2 seconds. The casting player will regain 2 MP every second if within range.

details.title: 链接友方
items: 链接友方单位，每2秒为其提供<color=focus_dark>6%</color>伤害加成。

details.title: 链接玩家单位
items: 叠加3次后，被链接对象若为玩家单位（包括时间转换器），玩家及被链接对象均额外提升<color=focus_dark>25%</color>攻击速度和20%移动速度。

details.title: 链接非玩家单位
items: 被链接对象若为非玩家单位，被链接单位额外提升<color=focus_dark>50%</color>攻击速度和20%移动速度。

details.title: 链接中断
items: 链接中断将解除上述增益效果。当非玩家单位被赋予全部增益效果后，链接自动中断，且不会随链接中断而移除该效果，但无法再被链接。

details.title: Establishing a Link
items: Establishes a link with a friendly unit, granting a stackable <color=focus_dark>6%</color> damage bonus every 2 seconds.

details.title: Link with a Student
items: At 3 stacks, both you and the linked student (Time-Turner versions included) will gain an extra <color=focus_dark>25%</color> attack speed and 20% movement speed.

details.title: Link with a Non-Student
items: A non-student unit linked by this effect will receive an extra <color=focus_dark>50%</color> attack speed and 20% movement speed.

details.title: Breaking the Link
items: Breaking the link will remove all Bonuses received. When a Summon is granted all Bonus effects, the link will automatically break, allowing the Summon to keep the Bonuses for the rest of the fight. However, it cannot be linked again.

details.title: Devastating Damage
items: When you deal effective damage to an opposing duellist with a Dark Card (excluding damage to Shields), you'll mark that duellist as your target and place a phantom of them at the hit location, with <color=focus_dark>13%</color> of the target's max Health. details.title: 人格魅力
items: 在格林德沃的激发下，伙伴卡被激发出了“输出型”、“策略型”、“生存型”三种不同潜能，当卡组中所有伙伴卡为同一潜能时激发出羁绊效果。

details.title: 咒语大师
items: 格林德沃善于使用4费及以上的咒语，激发羁绊效果后，对手牌中任意来源的，原始魔力消耗值为4及以上的咒语卡会有不同的常驻加成。

details.title: “输出型”
items: 伙伴卡的冷却时间减少。魔力消耗值4及以上的咒语卡，在使用时魔力消耗降低；使用伙伴卡后，巫师下一张使用的、未被强化过且非衍生的咒语卡的伤害将永久提升。

details.title: “策略型”
items: 伙伴卡的冷却时间减少。魔力消耗值4及以上的咒语卡的伤害提升；使用伙伴卡后，将复制1张巫师下次使用的非衍生咒语卡加入手牌，并进入卡组循环。复制的卡牌等级为当前卡组的平均卡牌等级。

details.title: “生存型”
items: 巫师使用魔力消耗值4及以上的咒语卡时，会恢复自身生命值。使用伙伴卡后，将在卡组中加入1张魔力消耗值降低的火盾护身，并进入卡组循环，火盾护身的卡牌等级为当前卡组的平均卡牌等级。

details.title: Charismatic Influence
items: Under Grindelwald's influence, Companion Cards awaken one of three potentials: 'Offence', 'Strategy', or 'Survival'. When all Companion Cards in your deck share the same potential, a Bond effect is activated.

details.title: Spell Mastery
items: Grindelwald favours spells costing 4 or more. After activating the Bond effect, spells in hand with an original cost of 4 or more gain permanent enhancements.

details.title: Offence Companions
items: Companion Card cooldown is reduced. Spells costing 4 or more cost less to cast. After playing a Companion Card, the next non-derivative spell that has not been enhanced gains a permanent damage increase.

details.title: Strategy Companions
items: Companion Card cooldown is reduced. Spells costing 4 or more deal increased damage. After playing a Companion Card, the next non-derivative spell cast is copied into your hand and enters the deck cycle. The copied spell's level equals the average level of your current deck.

details.title: Survival Companions
items: When casting a spell costing 4 or more, you restore Health. After playing a Companion Card, a reduced-cost Protego Diabolica is added to the deck and entered into the deck cycle. Its level equals the average level of your current deck.

For every 7 MP spent on Spell Cards, you receive a random Chess Piece with an enhancement effect.
This piece, and any other pieces you may have, will be consumed by your next Summon, receiving all effects.

details.title: 消耗魔力值强化召唤物
items:
玩家使用咒语卡时，每消耗5点魔力值，即可获得1枚随机棋子。
玩家使用召唤卡时，将消耗当前所有棋子，使该张召唤卡获得所消耗棋子的附加能力。
